facets.goal: Reduce tile scuffing during the fictional workshop packing exercise.
facets.mechanism: A felt sleeve cushions the corners while a folded paper cradle restrains sliding.
facets.population: Painted wooden tiles from nine invented workbench stations across six packing sessions.
facets.evaluation: Compare paired proportions of unscuffed tiles using a frozen packing protocol.

hypotheses.statement: Felt sleeves reduce the paired rate of visible tile scuffs compared with a paper cradle alone.

for.says: The synthetic inspection record reports fewer scuffed corners with the padded cradle.
